votes.motion: to approve the minutes of May 21, 2024

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Temporary Use Permit for the C-A-L Ranch Greenhouse, located at 2735 West 7800 South in an SC-2 zone, with the Conditions and Requirements of Approval listed in the report

based on the findings set forth in the staff report, to approve the Preliminary Site Plan for Valley View Office located at 7545 South Temple Drive with the Requirements of Approval in the staff report

to recommend approval (positive recommendation) of the Victory Builders Rezone, rezoning 2.54 acres located at 1390 West 9000 South from Neighborhood Shopping Center (SC-1) and Community Shopping Center (SC-2) to General Commercial (C-G) to the West Jordan City Council subject to all requirements of approval

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council to amend the West Jordan City Code as presented in the staff report
